articles.title: Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-producing states prompt concerns as India sets 2047 target
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, the highest-grade variety of iron ore.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With India’s iron ore demand projected to rise to 772 million tonnes (MT) by 2047, miners in Odisha, the country’s largest iron ore reserve holder, are yet to utilise nearly 40% of their existing capacities, raising concerns over resource wastage and potential revenue losses. The issue has come under judicial scrutiny, with both the Supreme Court earlier this month and the Odisha High Court in January flagging the underutilisation of mining capacities. The Odisha High Court, while agreeing with petitioners who highlighted the sluggish operationalisation of mines despite environmental clearances, observed that the delay had resulted in an average annual revenue loss of ₹4,000 crore to the State. However, industry sources, speaking on condition of anonymity, attributed the delays primarily to prolonged forest clearance procedures, which often exceed the stipulated 18-month timeframe. Data cited by petitioner Citizens’ Action Forum (Bhubaneswar) show that of the 246 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of mining capacity granted environmental clearance in FY25, only around 159 MTPA had been operationalised. Separately, data published by mining consultancy BigMint in June 2026 show that Odisha produced 158 MT of iron ore in FY26 against an environmentally cleared capacity of 278 MTPA, indicating capacity utilisation of nearly 60%. The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, which is among the highest-grade varieties of iron ore The shortfall also raises questions over India’s continued dependence on imports. According to the Mines Ministry, the country imported 12.3 MT of iron ore in FY26, incurring an expenditure of ₹11,115 crore. Odisha accounted for more than 50% of India’s domestic iron ore production during FY26. Chhattisgarh contributed around 17.1%, followed by Karnataka at 16.6%. Capacity utilisation in the two states – albeit with significantly lower volumes than Odisha – stood at 62% and 80%, respectively, according to calculations based on BigMint data.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In January, the Odisha High Court directed that mining rights be mandatorily transferred to state-owned National Mineral Development Corporation (NMDC) to ensure “optimum utilisation of the mines” and “eradicate any burden on the government exchequer”.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-producing states prompt concerns as India sets 2047 target

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 09:35:55 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, the highest-grade variety of iron ore.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With India’s iron ore demand projected to rise to 772 million tonnes (MT) by 2047, miners in Odisha, the country’s largest iron ore reserve holder, are yet to utilise nearly 40% of their existing capacities, raising concerns over resource wastage and potential revenue losses. The issue has come under judicial scrutiny, with both the Supreme Court earlier this month and the Odisha High Court in January flagging the underutilisation of mining capacities. The Odisha High Court, while agreeing with petitioners who highlighted the sluggish operationalisation of mines despite environmental clearances, observed that the delay had resulted in an average annual revenue loss of ₹4,000 crore to the State. However, industry sources, speaking on condition of anonymity, attributed the delays primarily to prolonged forest clearance procedures, which often exceed the stipulated 18-month timeframe. Data cited by petitioner Citizens’ Action Forum (Bhubaneswar) show that of the 246 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of mining capacity granted environmental clearance in FY25, only around 159 MTPA had been operationalised. Separately, data published by mining consultancy BigMint in June 2026 show that Odisha produced 158 MT of iron ore in FY26 against an environmentally cleared capacity of 278 MTPA, indicating capacity utilisation of nearly 60%. The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, which is among the highest-grade varieties of iron ore The shortfall also raises questions over India’s continued dependence on imports. According to the Mines Ministry, the country imported 12.3 MT of iron ore in FY26, incurring an expenditure of ₹11,115 crore. Odisha accounted for more than 50% of India’s domestic iron ore production during FY26. Chhattisgarh contributed around 17.1%, followed by Karnataka at 16.6%. Capacity utilisation in the two states – albeit with significantly lower volumes than Odisha – stood at 62% and 80%, respectively, according to calculations based on BigMint data.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In January, the Odisha High Court directed that mining rights be mandatorily transferred to state-owned National Mineral Development Corporation (NMDC) to ensure “optimum utilisation of the mines” and “eradicate any burden on the government exchequer”.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Operationalisation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Operationalisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Underutilisation (Adjective / Verb)
कम उपयोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Underutilisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-producing states prompt concerns as India sets 2047 target", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, the highest-grade variety of iron ore.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-pro' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The underutilised capacity is particularly significant as it largely involves hematite, the highest-grade variety of iron ore." (Hinglish Arth: कम उपयोग की गई क्षमता विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि इसमें बड़े पैमाने पर हेमेटाइट शामिल है, जो लौह अयस्क की उच्चतम श्रेणी की किस्म है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Iron ore capacity under-utilisation in major-producing states prompt concerns as India sets 2047 target"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In January, the Odisha High Court directed that mining rights be mandatorily transferred to state-owned National Mineral Development Corporation...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In January, the Odisha High Court directed that mining rights be mandatorily transferred to state-owned National Mineral Development Corporation..." (Hinglish Arth: जनवरी में, ओडिशा उच्च न्यायालय ने निर्देश दिया कि "खदानों का इष्टतम उपयोग" सुनिश्चित करने और "किसी भी बोझ को खत्म करने" के लिए खनन अधिकार अनिवार्य रूप से राज्य के स्वामित्व वाले राष्ट्रीय खनिज विकास निगम (एनएमडीसी) को हस्तांतरित कर दिए जाएं।)

articles.title: Police aspirant found dead, boyfriend and relatives arrested in Mahabubabad
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A 24-year-old woman preparing to join the Telangana Police was found dead at her house in Nadivada village of Mahabubabad district on November 12. Police have arrested her boyfriend Anil and his relatives in connection with the case.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The deceased, Sushmita belonged to the Madiga community. Her parents, Kumaraswamy and Sukanya, found her dead after returning home with their other daughter from a function that evening. According to Deputy Superintendent of Police N. Tirupathi Rao, Sushmita left behind an 18-page note accusing Anil, who belonged to the Goud community, of refusing to marry her despite being in a relationship with her for nearly two years. She had accused him of initially promising to marry her but later backing out, citing opposition from his family and friends over their different castes. In the note, Sushmita blamed Anil for her death and expressed regret over not being able to fulfil her ambition of joining the police force and making her parents proud. Police registered a case under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and for abetment to suicide against 11 persons, including Anil, his parents and other relatives. Further investigation is underway.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: (Roshini suicide prevention helpline number are: 8142020033/44 and 040 66202000/2001.)

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Police aspirant found dead, boyfriend and relatives arrested in Mahabubabad

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 11:21:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A 24-year-old woman preparing to join the Telangana Police was found dead at her house in Nadivada village of Mahabubabad district on November 12. Police have arrested her boyfriend Anil and his relatives in connection with the case.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The deceased, Sushmita belonged to the Madiga community. Her parents, Kumaraswamy and Sukanya, found her dead after returning home with their other daughter from a function that evening. According to Deputy Superintendent of Police N. Tirupathi Rao, Sushmita left behind an 18-page note accusing Anil, who belonged to the Goud community, of refusing to marry her despite being in a relationship with her for nearly two years. She had accused him of initially promising to marry her but later backing out, citing opposition from his family and friends over their different castes. In the note, Sushmita blamed Anil for her death and expressed regret over not being able to fulfil her ambition of joining the police force and making her parents proud. Police registered a case under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and for abetment to suicide against 11 persons, including Anil, his parents and other relatives. Further investigation is underway.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: (Roshini suicide prevention helpline number are: 8142020033/44 and 040 66202000/2001.)

A. A 24-year-old woman preparing to join the Telangana Police was found dead at her house in Nadivada village of Mahabubabad district on November 12.

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Police aspirant found dead, boyfriend and rel' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Police aspirant found dead, boyfriend and rel' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.title: Vijayawada Press Club to organise blood donation camp on November 16
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Vijayawada Press Club and the NTR Memorial Trust Blood Centre are jointly organising a free blood donation camp on November 16 to mark National Press Day.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The camp will be held at the Press Club in Gandhi Nagar from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Monday. CR Media Academy Chairman Alapati Suresh Kumar will be the chief guest and inaugurate the camp. Donors will be issued certificates by the NTR Trust. Those holding the certificates can avail themselves of blood transfusion services from the Trust at half the regular price if they need them in the future, according to a release.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Journalists willing to donate blood have been requested to register their names in advance at the Press Club.

📰 Vijayawada Press Club to organise blood donation camp on November 16

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 11:19:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

Those holding the certificates can avail themselves of blood transfusion services from the Trust at half the regular price if they need them in the future, according to a release.

articles.title: BJP accuses Congress of double standard on women’s issues
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj cited allegations against three Congress leaders, all of whom have denied them, and said the party and Rahul Gandhi had maintained a “conspicuous silence”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday (November 14, 2026) accused the Congress of following a double standard on the issue of women’s dignity, safety and empowerment by publicly advocating women’s rights while “remaining silent” on accusations of misconduct against its own leaders. At a press conference, BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj referred to Jharkhand Congress MLA Bhushan Bara, who has been accused of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old tribal girl; MP Vimal Akoijam, who faces allegations of sexual harassment in Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU); and Uttarakhand party leader Harak Singh Rawat, who was earlier accused of raping a woman from Assam. The woman, who claimed that she became pregnant after the alleged abuse, has now demanded a DNA test on her son. The three Congress leaders have denied the accusations. Ms. Swaraj questioned the “silence” of senior Congress leaders, saying that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the BJP government was empowering women to become self-reliant and nation-builders, while the Congress was limited to raising slogans. She alleged that the Congress continued to “repeatedly insult women”. “Tomorrow also marks the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda ji and Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas. On such an occasion, it is deeply shameful that Jharkhand Congress MLA Bhushan Bara is facing serious allegations of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old tribal girl,” she said. “It is surprising that the Congress, which raises hollow slogans such as ‘Smash the Patriarchy’, along with its Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Sonia Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, has once again chosen to maintain silence on this matter,” she alleged.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “All these cases are distinct from one another, whether it is the rape of a tribal girl, the appointment of Vimal Akoijam as co-chairman of manifesto committee, or the appointment of Harak Singh Rawat as chairman of the election management committee in Uttarakhand. However, one thing is common to all these cases: the conspicuous silence of the Congress party and Rahul Gandhi,” she said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 BJP accuses Congress of double standard on women’s issues

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:49:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj cited allegations against three Congress leaders, all of whom have denied them, and said the party and Rahul Gandhi had maintained a “conspicuous silence”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday (November 14, 2026) accused the Congress of following a double standard on the issue of women’s dignity, safety and empowerment by publicly advocating women’s rights while “remaining silent” on accusations of misconduct against its own leaders. At a press conference, BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj referred to Jharkhand Congress MLA Bhushan Bara, who has been accused of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old tribal girl; MP Vimal Akoijam, who faces allegations of sexual harassment in Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU); and Uttarakhand party leader Harak Singh Rawat, who was earlier accused of raping a woman from Assam. The woman, who claimed that she became pregnant after the alleged abuse, has now demanded a DNA test on her son. The three Congress leaders have denied the accusations. Ms. Swaraj questioned the “silence” of senior Congress leaders, saying that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the BJP government was empowering women to become self-reliant and nation-builders, while the Congress was limited to raising slogans. She alleged that the Congress continued to “repeatedly insult women”. “Tomorrow also marks the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda ji and Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas. On such an occasion, it is deeply shameful that Jharkhand Congress MLA Bhushan Bara is facing serious allegations of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old tribal girl,” she said. “It is surprising that the Congress, which raises hollow slogans such as ‘Smash the Patriarchy’, along with its Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Sonia Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, has once again chosen to maintain silence on this matter,” she alleged.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “All these cases are distinct from one another, whether it is the rape of a tribal girl, the appointment of Vimal Akoijam as co-chairman of manifesto committee, or the appointment of Harak Singh Rawat as chairman of the election management committee in Uttarakhand. However, one thing is common to all these cases: the conspicuous silence of the Congress party and Rahul Gandhi,” she said.

articles.title: Opposition parties, civil rights groups come together to save voters’ rights in West Bengal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The new platform calls for a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21, invites other parties and people whose names were ‘unlawfully’ removed from electoral rolls to take part

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Calling for people whose names were unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise to raise their voices, several opposition parties and civil rights groups on Saturday (November 14, 2026), announced a joint platform in West Bengal to save the rights of all voters. The members of the ‘Sara Bangla Votadhikar Rokkha Jukto Moncho’ (All Bengal Joint Forum to Safeguard Voting Rights) also invited all opposition political parties to attend a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21. “We are inviting all the opposition political parties to attend the convention. The voters whose names have been unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls are also being called upon to raise their voices through this platform to protect their constitutional right,” said economist and Congress leader Prasenjit Bose. Making an official announcement of the platform at a press conference on Saturday (November 14, 2026), its members said representatives of various parties, including the Congress, Mamata All India Trinamool Congress, Communist Party of India (CPI), Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPIM), along with civil rights groups like Bharat Jodo, Nagarik Rakkha Mancha, and Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR), will be present at the November 21 convention. People whose names have been deleted in the Special Intensive Revision will also join, they said. Mr. Bose said the united platform will raise six major questions to the Election Commission of India (ECI). “We want to know how long it will take the tribunals to dispose of lakhs of appeals pending before them. The State Election Commission must answer whether all the 22 lakh voters, who appealed to the tribunal for inclusion of their names, will be deprived of their voting rights in the upcoming municipality and panchayat elections,” he said. The SIR process in West Bengal was held from October 2025 to February 2026, just before the Assembly election, which saw the Bharatiya Janata Party come to power in the State for the first time. The names of over 91 lakh electors were deleted from the electoral rolls, accounting for a drop of about 13% in the number of voters in the State from before the start of the exercise. According to an affidavit filed in the Supreme Court by the ECI in September, of the 27 lakh electors excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of ‘logical discrepancies’, 22 lakh have filed appeals before the tribunal challenging the decision. The ECI’s affidavit added that 16.10 lakh appeals have also been filed against inclusions during the SIR. This puts the total number of appeals pending before the SIR tribunals at 38 lakh. The new platform alleged that the applications for inclusion of 16 lakh names were generated by former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Manoj Agrawal and demanded clarification on the appeals. It also sought information from the ECI on the number of eligible voters whose names have so far been restored in the electoral roll through Form 6 (used for inclusion of new voters) during the ongoing special summary revision (SSR). “We have found that the former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Manoj Agrawal, generated these applications against 16 lakh names. We want to know who are these people, why these applications have been issued against their names despite being included in the voters’ lists in the SIR. Do they belong to any specific community or any particular region? How have their names been chosen?” asked retired Indian Administrative Service officer and former Rajya Sabha member Jawhar Sircar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said that the former CEO will be ‘liable to a criminal prosecution’ if he fails to give a suitable reply to these questions as it will make it clear that something was wrong with the SIR exercise in the State.

hinglishTracks.en: The new platform calls for a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21, invites other parties and people whose names were ‘unlawfully’ removed from electoral rolls to take part
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नया मंच 21 नवंबर को कोलकाता में एक सामूहिक सम्मेलन का आह्वान करता है, जिसमें अन्य पार्टियों और लोगों को भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया है जिनके नाम 'गैरकानूनी' रूप से मतदाता सूची से हटा दिए गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Calling for people whose names were unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise to raise their voices, several opposition parties and civil rights groups on Saturday (November 14, 2026), announced a joint platform in West Bengal to save the rights of all voters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जिन लोगों के नाम विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) अभ्यास के दौरान मतदाता सूची से गैरकानूनी रूप से हटा दिए गए थे, उनकी आवाज उठाने का आह्वान करते हुए, कई विपक्षी दलों और नागरिक अधिकार समूहों ने शनिवार (14 नवंबर, 2026) को सभी मतदाताओं के अधिकारों को बचाने के लिए पश्चिम बंगाल में एक संयुक्त मंच की घोषणा की।।

hinglishTracks.en: The members of the ‘Sara Bangla Votadhikar Rokkha Jukto Moncho’ (All Bengal Joint Forum to Safeguard Voting Rights) also invited all opposition political parties to attend a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 'सारा बांग्ला मतदाता रोक्खा जुक्तो मोनचो' (वोटिंग अधिकारों की सुरक्षा के लिए ऑल बंगाल ज्वाइंट फोरम) के सदस्यों ने सभी विपक्षी राजनीतिक दलों को 21 नवंबर को कोलकाता में एक सामूहिक सम्मेलन में भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “We are inviting all the opposition political parties to attend the convention.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “हम सभी विपक्षी राजनीतिक दलों को सम्मेलन में भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित कर रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The voters whose names have been unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls are also being called upon to raise their voices through this platform to protect their constitutional right,” said economist and Congress leader Prasenjit Bose.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जिन मतदाताओं के नाम अवैध रूप से मतदाता सूची से हटा दिए गए हैं, उनसे भी अपने संवैधानिक अधिकार की रक्षा के लिए इस मंच के माध्यम से आवाज उठाने का आह्वान किया जा रहा है, ”अर्थशास्त्री और कांग्रेस नेता प्रसेनजीत बोस ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Making an official announcement of the platform at a press conference on Saturday (November 14, 2026), its members said representatives of various parties, including the Congress, Mamata All India Trinamool Congress, Communist Party of India (CPI), Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPIM), along with civil rights groups like Bharat Jodo, Nagarik Rakkha Mancha, and Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR), will be present at the November 21 convention.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — शनिवार (14 नवंबर, 2026) को एक संवाददाता सम्मेलन में मंच की आधिकारिक घोषणा करते हुए, इसके सदस्यों ने कहा कि कांग्रेस, ममता अखिल भारतीय तृणमूल कांग्रेस, भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (सीपीआई), भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (मार्क्सवादी) (सीपीआईएम) सहित विभिन्न दलों के प्रतिनिधि, भारत जोड़ो, नागरिक रक्खा मंच और एसोसिएशन फॉर प्रोटेक्शन ऑफ सिविल राइट्स (एपीसीआर) जैसे नागरिक अधिकार समूहों के साथ नवंबर में उपस्थित रहेंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: People whose names have been deleted in the Special Intensive Revision will also join, they said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने कहा कि विशेष सघन पुनरीक्षण में जिन लोगों के नाम हटा दिये गये हैं, वे भी शामिल हो जायेंगे.।

hinglishTracks.en: Bose said the united platform will raise six major questions to the Election Commission of India (ECI).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बोस ने कहा कि संयुक्त मंच भारत के चुनाव आयोग (ईसीआई) से छह प्रमुख सवाल उठाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: “We want to know how long it will take the tribunals to dispose of lakhs of appeals pending before them.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “हम जानना चाहते हैं कि न्यायाधिकरणों को उनके समक्ष लंबित लाखों अपीलों का निपटारा करने में कितना समय लगेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The State Election Commission must answer whether all the 22 lakh voters, who appealed to the tribunal for inclusion of their names, will be deprived of their voting rights in the upcoming municipality and panchayat elections,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — राज्य चुनाव आयोग को जवाब देना चाहिए कि क्या सभी 22 लाख मतदाता, जिन्होंने अपने नाम शामिल करने के लिए न्यायाधिकरण में अपील की थी, आगामी नगर पालिका और पंचायत चुनावों में अपने मतदान के अधिकार से वंचित हो जाएंगे, ”उन्होंने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: The SIR process in West Bengal was held from October 2025 to February 2026, just before the Assembly election, which saw the Bharatiya Janata Party come to power in the State for the first time.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पश्चिम बंगाल में एसआईआर प्रक्रिया विधानसभा चुनाव से ठीक पहले अक्टूबर 2025 से फरवरी 2026 तक आयोजित की गई थी, जिसमें भारतीय जनता पार्टी पहली बार राज्य में सत्ता में आई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The names of over 91 lakh electors were deleted from the electoral rolls, accounting for a drop of about 13% in the number of voters in the State from before the start of the exercise.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मतदाता सूची से 91 लाख से अधिक मतदाताओं के नाम हटा दिए गए, जिससे प्रक्रिया शुरू होने से पहले राज्य में मतदाताओं की संख्या में लगभग 13% की गिरावट आई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: According to an affidavit filed in the Supreme Court by the ECI in September, of the 27 lakh electors excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of ‘logical discrepancies’, 22 lakh have filed appeals before the tribunal challenging the decision.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सितंबर में ईसीआई द्वारा सुप्रीम कोर्ट में दायर एक हलफनामे के अनुसार, 'तार्किक विसंगतियों' के आधार पर मतदाता सूची से बाहर किए गए 27 लाख मतदाताओं में से 22 लाख ने फैसले को चुनौती देते हुए ट्रिब्यूनल के समक्ष अपील दायर की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The ECI’s affidavit added that 16.10 lakh appeals have also been filed against inclusions during the SIR.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ईसीआई के हलफनामे में कहा गया है कि एसआईआर के दौरान समावेशन के खिलाफ 16.10 लाख अपीलें भी दायर की गई हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: This puts the total number of appeals pending before the SIR tribunals at 38 lakh.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इससे एसआईआर ट्रिब्यूनल के समक्ष लंबित अपीलों की कुल संख्या 38 लाख हो गई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The new platform alleged that the applications for inclusion of 16 lakh names were generated by former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Manoj Agrawal and demanded clarification on the appeals.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नए मंच ने आरोप लगाया कि 16 लाख नामों को शामिल करने के लिए आवेदन पूर्व मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी (सीईओ) मनोज अग्रवाल द्वारा तैयार किए गए थे और अपीलों पर स्पष्टीकरण की मांग की गई थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: It also sought information from the ECI on the number of eligible voters whose names have so far been restored in the electoral roll through Form 6 (used for inclusion of new voters) during the ongoing special summary revision (SSR).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसने ईसीआई से उन पात्र मतदाताओं की संख्या के बारे में भी जानकारी मांगी, जिनके नाम अब तक चल रहे विशेष सारांश पुनरीक्षण (एसएसआर) के दौरान फॉर्म 6 (नए मतदाताओं को शामिल करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले) के माध्यम से मतदाता सूची में बहाल किए गए हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: “We have found that the former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Manoj Agrawal, generated these applications against 16 lakh names.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “हमने पाया है कि पूर्व मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी (सीईओ) मनोज अग्रवाल ने 16 लाख नामों के लिए ये आवेदन तैयार किए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: We want to know who are these people, why these applications have been issued against their names despite being included in the voters’ lists in the SIR.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हम जानना चाहते हैं कि ये लोग कौन हैं, एसआईआर में मतदाता सूची में शामिल होने के बावजूद उनके नाम के खिलाफ ये आवेदन क्यों जारी किए गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Do they belong to any specific community or any particular region?

hinglishTracks.en: How have their names been chosen?” asked retired Indian Administrative Service officer and former Rajya Sabha member Jawhar Sircar.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Opposition parties, civil rights groups come together to save voters’ rights in West Bengal

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:40:15 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The new platform calls for a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21, invites other parties and people whose names were ‘unlawfully’ removed from electoral rolls to take part

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Calling for people whose names were unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise to raise their voices, several opposition parties and civil rights groups on Saturday (November 14, 2026), announced a joint platform in West Bengal to save the rights of all voters. The members of the ‘Sara Bangla Votadhikar Rokkha Jukto Moncho’ (All Bengal Joint Forum to Safeguard Voting Rights) also invited all opposition political parties to attend a mass convention in Kolkata on November 21. “We are inviting all the opposition political parties to attend the convention. The voters whose names have been unlawfully deleted from the electoral rolls are also being called upon to raise their voices through this platform to protect their constitutional right,” said economist and Congress leader Prasenjit Bose. Making an official announcement of the platform at a press conference on Saturday (November 14, 2026), its members said representatives of various parties, including the Congress, Mamata All India Trinamool Congress, Communist Party of India (CPI), Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPIM), along with civil rights groups like Bharat Jodo, Nagarik Rakkha Mancha, and Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR), will be present at the November 21 convention. People whose names have been deleted in the Special Intensive Revision will also join, they said. Mr. Bose said the united platform will raise six major questions to the Election Commission of India (ECI). “We want to know how long it will take the tribunals to dispose of lakhs of appeals pending before them. The State Election Commission must answer whether all the 22 lakh voters, who appealed to the tribunal for inclusion of their names, will be deprived of their voting rights in the upcoming municipality and panchayat elections,” he said. The SIR process in West Bengal was held from October 2025 to February 2026, just before the Assembly election, which saw the Bharatiya Janata Party come to power in the State for the first time. The names of over 91 lakh electors were deleted from the electoral rolls, accounting for a drop of about 13% in the number of voters in the State from before the start of the exercise. According to an affidavit filed in the Supreme Court by the ECI in September, of the 27 lakh electors excluded from the electoral rolls on the ground of ‘logical discrepancies’, 22 lakh have filed appeals before the tribunal challenging the decision. The ECI’s affidavit added that 16.10 lakh appeals have also been filed against inclusions during the SIR. This puts the total number of appeals pending before the SIR tribunals at 38 lakh. The new platform alleged that the applications for inclusion of 16 lakh names were generated by former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Manoj Agrawal and demanded clarification on the appeals. It also sought information from the ECI on the number of eligible voters whose names have so far been restored in the electoral roll through Form 6 (used for inclusion of new voters) during the ongoing special summary revision (SSR). “We have found that the former Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Manoj Agrawal, generated these applications against 16 lakh names. We want to know who are these people, why these applications have been issued against their names despite being included in the voters’ lists in the SIR. Do they belong to any specific community or any particular region? How have their names been chosen?” asked retired Indian Administrative Service officer and former Rajya Sabha member Jawhar Sircar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said that the former CEO will be ‘liable to a criminal prosecution’ if he fails to give a suitable reply to these questions as it will make it clear that something was wrong with the SIR exercise in the State.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Inclusive (Adjective)
समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing  |  ✖ Ant: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow
Administrative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

articles.title: Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three hours over post against CEC
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Police questioned Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (MAITC) general secretary Abhishek Banerjee for over three hours on Saturday (November 14, 2026) in connection with a social media post against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Two days before the State Assembly election result was published, the Diamond Harbour MP had put up a post on his X handle calling the CEC a "puppet of the Gujarati gang". A first information report was lodged at the Bhawanipore police station on May 27 against him for allegedly hurting the sentiments of the Gujarati community through the post. On receipt of summons, he reached the Bhawanipore police station around 1.30 p.m. After leaving the police station, Mr. Banerjee said he was not afraid and stood by what he said. “Investigating agencies are doing their job. I have not run away. I respect the law enforcement agencies. But, I stand by what I said in the post. I had quoted a post by BJP leader Amit Malviya and called the BJP ‘anti-Bengal’,” he said. Mr. Banerjee said Mr. Malviya had earlier said that there was no language called Bengali and that it was actually ‘Bangaldeshi’ language. “BJP is the party that destroyed the statues of Vidyasagar (social reformer-writer) stopped Central funds for West Bengal, and insulted the Bengali culture several times,” he said. The development comes days after the Kolkata Municipal Corporation razed a tin shade and a boundary gate of Mr. Banerjee’s Kalighat residence. He has also appeared before the Crime Investigation Department (CID) twice in connection with a signature forgery case. On June 15, the Enforcement Directorate questioned him in Kolkata in connection with a money-laundering probe into the multi-crore West Bengal primary teachers’/school jobs recruitment scam.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Kolkata / West Bengal / All India Trinamool Congress

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three hours over post against CEC

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:37:40 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal Police questioned Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (MAITC) general secretary Abhishek Banerjee for over three hours on Saturday (November 14, 2026) in connection with a social media post against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Two days before the State Assembly election result was published, the Diamond Harbour MP had put up a post on his X handle calling the CEC a "puppet of the Gujarati gang". A first information report was lodged at the Bhawanipore police station on May 27 against him for allegedly hurting the sentiments of the Gujarati community through the post. On receipt of summons, he reached the Bhawanipore police station around 1.30 p.m. After leaving the police station, Mr. Banerjee said he was not afraid and stood by what he said. “Investigating agencies are doing their job. I have not run away. I respect the law enforcement agencies. But, I stand by what I said in the post. I had quoted a post by BJP leader Amit Malviya and called the BJP ‘anti-Bengal’,” he said. Mr. Banerjee said Mr. Malviya had earlier said that there was no language called Bengali and that it was actually ‘Bangaldeshi’ language. “BJP is the party that destroyed the statues of Vidyasagar (social reformer-writer) stopped Central funds for West Bengal, and insulted the Bengali culture several times,” he said. The development comes days after the Kolkata Municipal Corporation razed a tin shade and a boundary gate of Mr. Banerjee’s Kalighat residence. He has also appeared before the Crime Investigation Department (CID) twice in connection with a signature forgery case. On June 15, the Enforcement Directorate questioned him in Kolkata in connection with a money-laundering probe into the multi-crore West Bengal primary teachers’/school jobs recruitment scam.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Kolkata / West Bengal / All India Trinamool Congress

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Information' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Development (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Development' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three hours over post against CEC", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three hour' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three h' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three h' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner..." (Hinglish Arth: मई में उनके सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट के बारे में शिकायत के बाद टीएमसी सांसद के खिलाफ एफआईआर दर्ज की गई थी, जिसमें कथित तौर पर विधानसभा चुनाव के दौरान मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार और गुजरातियों को निशाना बनाया गया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Police question Abhishek Banerjee for three hours over post against CEC"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Kolkata / West Bengal / All India Trinamool Congress.

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Kolkata / West Bengal / All India Trinamool Congress." (Hinglish Arth: कोलकाता/पश्चिम बंगाल/अखिल भारतीय तृणमूल कांग्रेस)

articles.title: Keralam Speaker’s absence from endosulfan victims’ memorial event triggers row
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Thiruvanchoor blames ‘communication lapse’ for not attending the unveiling of the 40-foot-tall sculpture created by sculptor Kanayi Kunhiraman; Kasaragod district panchayat maintains that he was informed through proper channels

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Assembly Speaker Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan’s absence from the unveiling of a sculpture honouring endosulfan victims in Kasaragod has triggered a row, with the Speaker and the district panchayat offering conflicting accounts of the happenings. The Speaker was scheduled to unveil the 40-foot-tall sculpture, titled ‘Victims,’ created by sculptor Kanayi Kunhiraman at the Kasaragod district panchayat office on Friday. However, he skipped the function and attended another programme in the neighbouring Kannur district. His absence drew criticism from artists and public representatives, including Manjeswaram MLA A.K.M. Ashraf. Speaking to reporters on Saturday, Mr. Radhakrishnan said he had waited until the last minute for proper communication from the organisers before cancelling his ticket. “As there was no communication from the organisers, I cancelled the ticket. Later, I booked another ticket and went to Kannur,” he said. He said he had expected the organisers to explain the circumstances but decided to clarify his position himself as they remained silent. “It was a very unfortunate incident. I have nothing more to say,” he added. However, Kasaragod district panchayat president Sabu Abraham disputed the Speaker’s account, maintaining that he had been informed about the event through proper channels and that the organisers had made every effort to secure his participation. Mr. Abraham said the invitation was initially extended through Uduma MLA K. Neelakandan, who had met the Speaker during the Assembly session and obtained a date for the programme. The district panchayat subsequently sent an official letter to the Speaker’s office. After the programme was finalised at a board meeting on November 6, the organisers sent the detailed schedule and a formal communication to the Speaker, he said. Mr. Abraham said he had personally telephoned the Speaker on the night of November 11 and requested him to attend the event. He also contacted the Speaker’s private secretary the following morning to enquire about his travel arrangements. “The private secretary advised me to contact the Speaker directly, following which I called him and explained the arrangements. During the conversation, the Speaker mentioned certain confusion and also referred to the MLA not answering his phone,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said he had assured the Speaker that all arrangements were in place and urged him to attend, pointing out that the occasion marked an important milestone in the career of Mr. Kunhiraman.Mr. Abraham said he had also contacted Mr. Neelakandan the following morning and asked him to speak to the Speaker to ensure his participation.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Keralam Speaker’s absence from endosulfan victims’ memorial event triggers row

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:37:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Thiruvanchoor blames ‘communication lapse’ for not attending the unveiling of the 40-foot-tall sculpture created by sculptor Kanayi Kunhiraman; Kasaragod district panchayat maintains that he was informed through proper channels

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Assembly Speaker Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan’s absence from the unveiling of a sculpture honouring endosulfan victims in Kasaragod has triggered a row, with the Speaker and the district panchayat offering conflicting accounts of the happenings. The Speaker was scheduled to unveil the 40-foot-tall sculpture, titled ‘Victims,’ created by sculptor Kanayi Kunhiraman at the Kasaragod district panchayat office on Friday. However, he skipped the function and attended another programme in the neighbouring Kannur district. His absence drew criticism from artists and public representatives, including Manjeswaram MLA A.K.M. Ashraf. Speaking to reporters on Saturday, Mr. Radhakrishnan said he had waited until the last minute for proper communication from the organisers before cancelling his ticket. “As there was no communication from the organisers, I cancelled the ticket. Later, I booked another ticket and went to Kannur,” he said. He said he had expected the organisers to explain the circumstances but decided to clarify his position himself as they remained silent. “It was a very unfortunate incident. I have nothing more to say,” he added. However, Kasaragod district panchayat president Sabu Abraham disputed the Speaker’s account, maintaining that he had been informed about the event through proper channels and that the organisers had made every effort to secure his participation. Mr. Abraham said the invitation was initially extended through Uduma MLA K. Neelakandan, who had met the Speaker during the Assembly session and obtained a date for the programme. The district panchayat subsequently sent an official letter to the Speaker’s office. After the programme was finalised at a board meeting on November 6, the organisers sent the detailed schedule and a formal communication to the Speaker, he said. Mr. Abraham said he had personally telephoned the Speaker on the night of November 11 and requested him to attend the event. He also contacted the Speaker’s private secretary the following morning to enquire about his travel arrangements. “The private secretary advised me to contact the Speaker directly, following which I called him and explained the arrangements. During the conversation, the Speaker mentioned certain confusion and also referred to the MLA not answering his phone,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said he had assured the Speaker that all arrangements were in place and urged him to attend, pointing out that the occasion marked an important milestone in the career of Mr. Kunhiraman.Mr. Abraham said he had also contacted Mr. Neelakandan the following morning and asked him to speak to the Speaker to ensure his participation.

articles.title: Amidst Indus water tensions, Pakistan to send vocal critic to SCO Civilisational Dialogue; first Ministerial visit in three years
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Dr. Malik, the Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, had earlier this year said that Pakistan would ‘cut off those hands’ that are trying to control the Indus waters

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first Pakistani Minister to visit India in more than three years, Musadik Masood Malik, has been a vocal critic of New Delhi’s decision to place the Indus Waters Treaty “in abeyance” following the April 2025 Pahalgam terrorist attack. Dr. Malik is Pakistan’s Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination and will represent his country at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue to be held here from November 20 to 22, Islamabad announced on Saturday. The last Pakistani Minister to visit India was Bilawal Bhutto who had visited Goa in May 2023 for the SCO Foreign Ministers meeting. JUST IN | Pakistan has nominated Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Dr. Musadik Masood Malik, to represent the country at the SCO Civilisational Dialogue, scheduled to be held in New Delhi from November 20 to November 22. - @suhasinih reports 📸 Special Arrangement The Hindu had reported on October 28 that the Indian government had invited Pakistan’s Minister for National Heritage and Culture Aurungzeb Khan Khichi to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue event, the first such Ministerial-level invitation since 2023. However, the Pakistani government has nominated a different representative. “The Government of Pakistan remains committed to promoting dialogue among civilisations and fostering people to people contacts within the SCO framework in a spirit of mutual respect,” the Pakistan government said in a statement on Saturday. India and Pakistan engaged in military hostilities after the terror attack in Pahalgam, following which India placed the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) “in abeyance”. Mr. Malik, a technocrat turned Minister, said in a press conference in June this year that Pakistan would “cut off those hands” that are attempting to control the Indus waters. Asserting its claim on the Indus, Pakistan has been highlighting the Indus Valley civilisation of Mohenjodaro and Harappa and other ancient sites in the country in recent months. On World Heritage Day on April 18, Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif had referred to the Indus Valley civilisation in his remarks, saying, “Pakistan’s cultural heritage is enriched with a multifaceted civilisation. Our homeland carries the legacy of some of the world’s oldest civilisations, reflecting a vibrant tapestry of human creativity and diversity.” On Friday (November 13, 2026), Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat said India and Pakistan have a shared “civilisational and cultural” past, adding that New Delhi hopes that Pakistan will attend the upcoming SCO Civilisational Dialogue. China, Kazakhstan, Iran, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan are among the countries that have already confirmed their participation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I believe that Pakistan’s civilisational and cultural progress is no different from ours,” Mr. Shekhawat said, in response to a question about the invitation, given the tensions with Pakistan. “They [Pakistan] separated from us less than 100 years ago, but prior to that, we [India and Pakistan] have evolved together. So we should not have any differences over these issues,” he added.

Dr. Malik is Pakistan’s Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination and will represent his country at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue to be held here from November 20 to 22, Islamabad announced on Saturday. The last Pakistani Minister to visit India was Bilawal Bhutto who had visited Goa in May 2023 for the SCO Foreign Ministers meeting. However, the Pakistani government has nominated a different representative. “The Government of Pakistan remains committed to promoting dialogue among civilisations and fostering people to people contacts within the SCO framework in a spirit of mutual respect,” the Pakistan government said in a statement on Saturday. India and Pakistan engaged in military hostilities after the terror attack in Pahalgam, following which India placed the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) “in abeyance”. Mr. Malik, a technocrat turned Minister, said in a press conference in June this year that Pakistan would “cut off those hands” that are attempting to control the Indus waters. Asserting its claim on the Indus, Pakistan has been highlighting the Indus Valley civilisation of Mohenjodaro and Harappa and other ancient sites in the country in recent months. On World Heritage Day on April 18, Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif had referred to the Indus Valley civilisation in his remarks, saying, “Pakistan’s cultural heritage is enriched with a multifaceted civilisation. Our homeland carries the legacy of some of the world’s oldest civilisations, reflecting a vibrant tapestry of human creativity and diversity.” On Friday (November 13, 2026), Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat said India and Pakistan have a shared “civilisational and cultural” past, adding that New Delhi hopes that Pakistan will attend the upcoming SCO Civilisational Dialogue. China, Kazakhstan, Iran, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan are among the countries that have already confirmed their participation.

3. articles.title: Rubio acknowledges ’people are struggling’ economically in speech after GOP midterm wipeout
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Marco Rubio’s comments to the conservative Federalist Society touched on a core issue of the midterm elections — economic pain — that U.S. voters cited in delivering massive losses to Republican Party

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Secretary of State Marco Rubio gave a sweeping speech to fellow conservatives on Friday evening (November 13, 2026), acknowledging that Americans are struggling in the current economy, while also railing against what he called the “weaponisation” of international law to constrain the U.S. from acting in its own interests. “I think we have to recognise that people are struggling. There’s no doubt about it,” he said. “The health of our economy has nothing to do with the stock market. The health of their economy is whether they have enough money to be able to afford the things they need.” President Donald Trump often points to the stock market as evidence that the economy is doing well. But voters, angry over higher costs, gave Democrats control of Congress after blaming Trump for his tariffs, his war in Iran and his unfulfilled campaign promise two years ago to bring down prices. Mr. Rubio's remarks had the overtones of campaign speech, though the former Florida senator has consistently refused to discuss whether he would seek the presidency in 2028 in a race that could pit him against Vice President J.D. Vance. Mr. Rubio gave another wide-ranging speech last month in Greece that focused on Western values and also appeared to reflect his political aspirations beyond being America’s top diplomat. ALSO WATCH U.S. midterm elections: What India is watching after Trump’s setback | Worldview Mr. Rubio on Friday (November 13, 2026) defended the Iran war, arguing that it was necessary to stop the threat of the Islamic Republic obtaining a nuclear weapon. But he acknowledged that the unpopular conflict has driven up gasoline prices for Americans and other connected costs. “It’s not easy to address these things because it’s not popular to address them," Mr. Rubio said. “It’s difficult. And oftentimes it inflicts, you know, pain, economic pain and otherwise. So we recognise that.” He also pointed to the need for American leaders to continue a tradition of ensuring the next generation is better off than those before them. Economic prosperity is “not self-perpetuating,” he said, but an enormous undertaking that requires years and decades and is not accomplished “election cycle to election cycle." Trump debacle: On the U.S. midterm election results

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “That’s the challenge before us now, because I do think there’s a legitimate fear that we will be the first generation to leave the next worse off, and that can’t happen. That’s un-American,” he said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Rubio acknowledges ’people are struggling’ economically in speech after GOP midterm wipeout

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:30:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Marco Rubio’s comments to the conservative Federalist Society touched on a core issue of the midterm elections — economic pain — that U.S. voters cited in delivering massive losses to Republican Party

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Secretary of State Marco Rubio gave a sweeping speech to fellow conservatives on Friday evening (November 13, 2026), acknowledging that Americans are struggling in the current economy, while also railing against what he called the “weaponisation” of international law to constrain the U.S. from acting in its own interests. “I think we have to recognise that people are struggling. There’s no doubt about it,” he said. “The health of our economy has nothing to do with the stock market. The health of their economy is whether they have enough money to be able to afford the things they need.” President Donald Trump often points to the stock market as evidence that the economy is doing well. But voters, angry over higher costs, gave Democrats control of Congress after blaming Trump for his tariffs, his war in Iran and his unfulfilled campaign promise two years ago to bring down prices. Mr. Rubio's remarks had the overtones of campaign speech, though the former Florida senator has consistently refused to discuss whether he would seek the presidency in 2028 in a race that could pit him against Vice President J.D. Vance. Mr. Rubio gave another wide-ranging speech last month in Greece that focused on Western values and also appeared to reflect his political aspirations beyond being America’s top diplomat. ALSO WATCH U.S. midterm elections: What India is watching after Trump’s setback | Worldview Mr. Rubio on Friday (November 13, 2026) defended the Iran war, arguing that it was necessary to stop the threat of the Islamic Republic obtaining a nuclear weapon. But he acknowledged that the unpopular conflict has driven up gasoline prices for Americans and other connected costs. “It’s not easy to address these things because it’s not popular to address them," Mr. Rubio said. “It’s difficult. And oftentimes it inflicts, you know, pain, economic pain and otherwise. So we recognise that.” He also pointed to the need for American leaders to continue a tradition of ensuring the next generation is better off than those before them. Economic prosperity is “not self-perpetuating,” he said, but an enormous undertaking that requires years and decades and is not accomplished “election cycle to election cycle." Trump debacle: On the U.S. midterm election results

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “That’s the challenge before us now, because I do think there’s a legitimate fear that we will be the first generation to leave the next worse off, and that can’t happen. That’s un-American,” he said.

articles.title: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, sources say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The war has hiked global fuel prices and proven unpopular with U.S. voters, who handed control ‌of ⁠Congress to the Democrats in last week's midterm elections

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. President Donald Trump has told senior advisers in recent ​days that he may hold off on attacking Iran if the U.S. faces no new provocations from Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, according to three people familiar ‌with the matter. Mr. Trump has alternated between threats of escalating the war with new strikes and winding down hostilities, ​and current and former officials say he does not appear to have made up his mind about how to resolve the ⁠unpopular conflict, which he launched in February with Israel. But in meetings with his national security advisers and after a series of intelligence briefings, Mr. Trump said he was considering holding off on strikes, said the people, who, like others interviewed for this story, spoke on condition of anonymity. He has also indicated sympathy for allies in the region ‌who have asked him not to return to a full-fledged war. "I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect, we are doing it a little bit longer way, a bit more civilly," Mr. Trump ‌told sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith on Thursday. The war has hiked global fuel prices and proven unpopular with U.S. voters, who handed control ‌of ⁠Congress to the Democrats in last week's midterm elections. In a Reuters /Ipsos poll taken shortly before the November 3 elections, 55% ⁠of Americans said the war was not worth the cost, and Vice-President J.D. Vance cited it as the reason Mr. Trump's Republicans lost Congress. "As Commander-in-Chief, President Trump is the architect and sole decision-maker who holds all the cards and will always ensure that America’s interests are ​protected," a White House official said in a statement. "The United States ‌is in a very strong position with control of the Strait of Hormuz and the Iranian economy collapsing. Only President Trump knows what he will do, and when." The CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not respond to requests for comment. In phone calls over the past two weeks, Mr. Trump asked for opinions from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Turkish President ‌Tayyip Erdogan, who both urged him not to resume attacks on Iran, according to a senior U.S. official and another person familiar ​with the matter. They said Mr. Trump made no commitment either way.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Trump told Mr. bin Salman on October 31 that he was planning to attack after the elections, but the crown prince pleaded for him to hold off, arguing that economic sanctions ⁠against Iran were working, according to two more people familiar with the discussion.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. President Donald Trump has told senior advisers in recent ​days that he may hold off on attacking Iran if the U.S. faces no new provocations from Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, according to three people familiar ‌with the matter. Mr. Trump has alternated between threats of escalating the war with new strikes and winding down hostilities, ​and current and former officials say he does not appear to have made up his mind about how to resolve the ⁠unpopular conflict, which he launched in February with Israel. But in meetings with his national security advisers and after a series of intelligence briefings, Mr. Trump said he was considering holding off on strikes, said the people, who, like others interviewed for this story, spoke on condition of anonymity. He has also indicated sympathy for allies in the region ‌who have asked him not to return to a full-fledged war. "I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect, we are doing it a little bit longer way, a bit more civilly," Mr. Trump ‌told sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith on Thursday. The war has hiked global fuel prices and proven unpopular with U.S. voters, who handed control ‌of ⁠Congress to the Democrats in last week's midterm elections. In a Reuters /Ipsos poll taken shortly before the November 3 elections, 55% ⁠of Americans said the war was not worth the cost, and Vice-President J.D. Vance cited it as the reason Mr. Trump's Republicans lost Congress. "As Commander-in-Chief, President Trump is the architect and sole decision-maker who holds all the cards and will always ensure that America’s interests are ​protected," a White House official said in a statement. "The United States ‌is in a very strong position with control of the Strait of Hormuz and the Iranian economy collapsing. Only President Trump knows what he will do, and when." The CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not respond to requests for comment. In phone calls over the past two weeks, Mr. Trump asked for opinions from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Turkish President ‌Tayyip Erdogan, who both urged him not to resume attacks on Iran, according to a senior U.S. official and another person familiar ​with the matter. They said Mr. Trump made no commitment either way.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Trump told Mr. bin Salman on October 31 that he was planning to attack after the elections, but the crown prince pleaded for him to hold off, arguing that economic sanctions ⁠against Iran were working, according to two more people familiar with the discussion.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, sources say

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 10:19:20 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The war has hiked global fuel prices and proven unpopular with U.S. voters, who handed control ‌of ⁠Congress to the Democrats in last week's midterm elections

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. President Donald Trump has told senior advisers in recent ​days that he may hold off on attacking Iran if the U.S. faces no new provocations from Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, according to three people familiar ‌with the matter. Mr. Trump has alternated between threats of escalating the war with new strikes and winding down hostilities, ​and current and former officials say he does not appear to have made up his mind about how to resolve the ⁠unpopular conflict, which he launched in February with Israel. But in meetings with his national security advisers and after a series of intelligence briefings, Mr. Trump said he was considering holding off on strikes, said the people, who, like others interviewed for this story, spoke on condition of anonymity. He has also indicated sympathy for allies in the region ‌who have asked him not to return to a full-fledged war. "I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect, we are doing it a little bit longer way, a bit more civilly," Mr. Trump ‌told sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith on Thursday. The war has hiked global fuel prices and proven unpopular with U.S. voters, who handed control ‌of ⁠Congress to the Democrats in last week's midterm elections. In a Reuters /Ipsos poll taken shortly before the November 3 elections, 55% ⁠of Americans said the war was not worth the cost, and Vice-President J.D. Vance cited it as the reason Mr. Trump's Republicans lost Congress. "As Commander-in-Chief, President Trump is the architect and sole decision-maker who holds all the cards and will always ensure that America’s interests are ​protected," a White House official said in a statement. "The United States ‌is in a very strong position with control of the Strait of Hormuz and the Iranian economy collapsing. Only President Trump knows what he will do, and when." The CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not respond to requests for comment. In phone calls over the past two weeks, Mr. Trump asked for opinions from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Turkish President ‌Tayyip Erdogan, who both urged him not to resume attacks on Iran, according to a senior U.S. official and another person familiar ​with the matter. They said Mr. Trump made no commitment either way.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Trump told Mr. bin Salman on October 31 that he was planning to attack after the elections, but the crown prince pleaded for him to hold off, arguing that economic sanctions ⁠against Iran were working, according to two more people familiar with the discussion.

articles.title: Jensen Huang | AI rainmaker meets his Waterloo
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Nvidia chief’s abrupt exit marks a stunning fall from grace for the man who built the hardware foundation of the AI revolution, forged deep ties with Silicon Valley’s tech leaders and expanded the company’s reach across every layer of the AI stack

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “In another life, Jensen Huang might have been a teacher,” says Tae Kim in his book The Nvidia Way . Whether he likes it or not, the Nvidia co-founder’s reality has now been reset, forcing him back to his idiosyncratic style of solving problems: diagramming on a whiteboard. But this time he won’t get a clean start as the scandal-hit former chief of Nvidia will face intense scrutiny over his affair with a Chinese businesswoman who is at the centre of an alleged spy scandal.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Within days of reports emerging about Mr. Huang’s affair with Alice Huang, The New York Times reported a second relationship, with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s head of healthcare and one of his direct reports. By then, the controversy had come to a head, forcing Mr. Huang to resign as CEO of Nvidia, the company he had built from scratch.

articles.title: Anthropic’s valuation can’t secure its moat
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Its engineers need to keep building progressively more capable models; the AI firm has also not established that it will be able to sustain its profitability after honouring its infra commitments

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Artificial intelligence (AI) company Anthropic, best known as the maker of the Claude AI model, is preparing to go public at a valuation of $1.4 trillion, which could make the IPO one of the largest in history. However, this particular refrain has of late seemed more ominous than cause for optimism, and the Anthropic IPO could be no exception. The company has said it will offer 825 million shares at $70-78 apiece, to raise up to $64.4 billion. The valuation includes shares to be issued through employee options and other arrangements, and its market capitalisation based on outstanding shares is likely to be near $1 trillion. (It was valued at $965 billion in a private funding round in May.) Anthropic’s financial prospects depend on continuing to spend extraordinary sums of money. Its amended prospectus filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 10 revealed roughly $900 billion in spending commitments, almost entirely for computing infrastructure, until 2045. Of this, the company expects to incur half by 2030 and $70.7 billion in the twelve months from September 30. The filing also mentions another $150-175 billion in potential payments under arrangements sans fixed dollar commitments. These figures clarify a colossal exposure to future demand that neither Anthropic nor other Big AI companies have thus far been able to guarantee. And while Anthropic’s revenue has also been growing, from $2.5 billion in the first three quarters of 2025 to $33.2 billion in the corresponding slice of 2026, the proposed fully diluted valuation exceeds annualised sales 17-fold. The current business model is, largely, to charge customers according to how many tokens they use to run their tasks on its AI models. From January to September 2026, this revenue constituted 79% of the total revenue, giving Anthropic a reason to encourage users to maximise token use, irrespective of changes in the value of the output generated — a tendency famously called tokenmaxxing. But three factors complicate this picture. First, Anthropic has said AI models released within the last six months accounted for more than 80% of its third quarter revenue, which means its engineers need to keep building progressively more capable models. Second, it has not established that it will be able to sustain its profitability after honouring its infrastructure commitments. The third factor is the most important, however: neither Anthropic nor its competitors, including OpenAI, currently has a lasting competitive advantage, a.k.a. a moat. In fact, the difficulties of securing a moat are better illustrated by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s position of late, in favour of new regulatory and compliance demands. These demands could impose costs that larger AI companies will bear more easily than smaller ones.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Legitimate reasons to regulate AI include security failures and the risks posed by autonomous systems but governments should endeavour overtly to prevent such regulatory capture given the perverse incentives facing AI companies.

hinglishTracks.en: Securities and Exchange Commission on November 10 revealed roughly $900 billion in spending commitments, almost entirely for computing infrastructure, until 2045.
